title.zhHans: 阿兰·图灵提出模仿游戏

summary.en: Alan Turing publishes "Computing Machinery and Intelligence", introducing the Turing Test for machine behavior.
summary.zhHans: 阿兰·图灵发表经典论文《计算机器与智能》，首次定义了著名的“图灵测试”，指明机器智能的标准。

narrative.en: The fountainhead of AI philosophy. By shifting the debate away from the metaphysical "can machines think" to the behavioral "can a machine mimic human chat," Turing established a benchmark that remains relevant in the era of LLMs.
narrative.zhHans: 这是现代人工智能思想的终极源泉。图灵避开了复杂的“机器是否能思考”的哲学争论，转而用“模仿游戏”的客观行为测试来定义智能。半个多世纪过去了，图灵测试至今仍在大模型主宰交互的当下被反复引用。

title.zhHans: 达特茅斯人工智能会议举行

summary.en: John McCarthy, Marvin Minsky, and others gather, coining the term "Artificial Intelligence".
summary.zhHans: 麦卡锡、明斯基等人共同发起，首次提出“人工智能 (Artificial Intelligence)”概念。

narrative.en: The formal founding moment of AI as an academic discipline. The organizers famously estimated that a 2-month, 10-man study could make significant progress on machine learning and cognitive reasoning, setting off the first wave of optimistic AI research.
narrative.zhHans: 这是人工智能正式作为独立学术领域的诞生时刻。在这场为期两月的研讨会上，学者们乐观地预言，只要十个聪明人合作一夏天，就能在学习、推理等智能问题上取得决定性进展，为随后的理性主义AI时代拉开了序幕。

title.zhHans: 反向传播算法被普及推广

summary.en: Hinton and colleagues publish in Nature, making backpropagation the anchor for training multi-layer neural networks.
summary.zhHans: Hinton等学者在《自然》发表文章，使反向传播算法成为训练多层神经网络的核心工具。

narrative.en: While the math of backpropagation was derived earlier, this paper demonstrated its ability to discover internal representations in hidden layers. It bridged the mathematical and engineering pathways for modern gradient descent.
narrative.zhHans: 虽然反向传播思想早已存在，但这篇论文证明了它在多层前馈神经网络中自动提取内部表征的能力。它为神经网络的自动微分训练打通了数学和工程的路径，使得训练更深维度的多层网络成为可能。

title.zhHans: 深蓝计算机击败卡斯帕罗夫

summary.en: IBM's supercomputer defeats the world chess champion Garry Kasparov, proving classical search efficiency.
summary.zhHans: IBM 的“深蓝”超级计算机击败国际象棋世界冠军卡斯帕罗夫，宣告了经典暴力搜索的威力。

narrative.en: Referred to as the "last stand of the human brain," Deep Blue relied on brute force chess acceleration hardware calculating 200 million positions per second. Though distinct from neural nets, it fundamentally breached human cognitive defenses.
narrative.zhHans: 这次人机大战被称为“大脑的最后一战”。深蓝依托硬件暴力加速和评估算法，每秒能计算两亿步。尽管它与今天大语言模型的神经网络架构毫无共通之处，但它彻底改变了公众对“机器能否超越人类智商”的心理防线。

title.zhHans: AlexNet 赢得 ImageNet 挑战赛

summary.en: A deep convolutional neural network crushes computer vision benchmarks, starting the current deep learning wave.
summary.zhHans: 深度卷积神经网络 AlexNet 以巨大优势在视觉识别挑战赛中夺冠，引爆了现代深度学习海啸。

narrative.en: Using GPU acceleration and deep layers, AlexNet slashed the ImageNet top-5 error rate from 26% to 16%. It proved to the world that representation learning and deep networks had rendered manual hand-engineered features obsolete.
narrative.zhHans: AlexNet 凭借 GPU 加速与卷积深度网络的结合，将 ImageNet 图像识别的错误率从 26% 骤降至 16%，用无可辩驳的数据向世界证明了：手工设计特征的时代结束了，表征学习与大规模深度学习将统治计算机视觉。

summary.en: DeepMind's AlphaGo wins 4:1 against 18-time world champion Lee Sedol, proving intuition-like heuristics in huge search spaces.
summary.zhHans: DeepMind 的 AlphaGo 在围棋对决中 4:1 战胜世界冠军李世石，展现了在极其开阔搜索空间中的非凡直觉。

narrative.en: This landmark match shattered the myth of Go as a game untouchable by machines. AlphaGo's infamous "Move 37" in game 2 transcended centuries of human textbooks, demonstrating neural network-driven "machine intuition" to the public.
narrative.zhHans: 这场对局彻底粉碎了“AI 围棋无法战胜人类顶尖棋手”的预言。AlphaGo 在第 2 局中下出的第 37 手突破了人类数千年棋谱的常规，首次向普罗大众展示了神经网络在没有硬编码启发式规则下具备发散思维和“直觉倾向”。

summary.en: Google researchers publish "Attention Is All You Need", introducing self-attention which anchors all modern LLMs.
summary.zhHans: 谷歌研究员发表《Attention Is All You Need》，引入自注意力机制，奠定了所有现代大语言模型的地基。

narrative.en: The Transformer bypassed the sequential processing bottleneck of traditional RNNs, enabling massively parallel training. Its self-attention mechanism quickly unified natural language and multimodal research, providing the foundation for GPT and Midjourney.
narrative.zhHans: Transformer 突破了传统循环神经网络（RNN）难以进行长依赖并行训练的瓶颈。它用简单的自注意力机制（Self-Attention）横扫 NLP 乃至多模态领域，成为包括 GPT 系列、Claude 以及 Midjourney 等大模型最底层的架构积木。

title.zhHans: GPT-3 开启少样本提示词时代

summary.en: OpenAI releases GPT-3 with 175B parameters, shifting NLP research from task-specific fine-tuning to generic few-shot prompts.
summary.zhHans: OpenAI 推出 1750 亿参数的 GPT-3，确立了通过少样本提示（Few-shot prompting）执行通用任务的路线。

narrative.en: GPT-3 demonstrated the sheer power of Scaling Laws. By reaching 175 billion parameters, it performed diverse text tasks without weight updates, introducing the software industry to prompt engineering.
narrative.zhHans: GPT-3 以 1750 亿参数的恐怖规模让业界看到了“尺度定律（Scaling Law）”的威力。它无需针对特定任务微调，只需给出几个输入输出示例（Few-Shot），就能直接理解并生成各种文本和简单代码，开启了基于 Prompting 的交互新时代。

title.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 与 DALL-E 1 推出

summary.en: Code automation and visual synthesis enter public workflows, spinning the flywheel of generative AI.
summary.zhHans: 文字生成代码与图像进入实用阶段，生成式 AI 的双轮驱动正式运转。

narrative.en: In 2021, writing code (GitHub Copilot) and creating digital art (DALL-E) transitioned to paid products. This drastically optimized developer velocity while starting initial debates on data licensing and training copyright.
narrative.zhHans: 2021年，代码编写（Copilot，基于 Codex）与创意绘图（DALL-E 1，基于连接 CLIP）首次走出实验室，成为白领日常辅助的高效工具。这不仅大幅提升了编程生产力，也拉开了 AI 商业化收费和版权伦理纷争的序幕。

summary.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT，将超大规模语言模型直观地推向大众，触发了人类社会全方位的 AI 军备竞赛。

narrative.en: The release of ChatGPT was the ultimate sociological catalyst in AI history. Breaking accessibility barriers with a chat UI, generative AI saturated daily work and academic writing overnight, raising massive debates on copyright, education, and labor.

title.zhHans: NVIDIA H100 确立 AI 算力主权

summary.en: NVIDIA Hopper architecture (H100) becomes the physical currency for frontier training, making compute a strategic national asset.

narrative.en: Built with Hopper architecture and a dedicated Transformer Engine, the H100 sped up training workloads of trillion-parameter models. Sovereign states and hyperscalers scrambled to hoard GPUs, making AI computing capability the ultimate strategic baseline.

title.zhHans: 百万级上下文与视频生成

summary.en: Context windows scale up to 2M tokens, transforming raw analysis of documents and codebases, alongside Sora video simulation.
summary.zhHans: 上下文窗口扩大至200万Tokens，突破海量数据物理界限，Sora开启物理世界生成式模拟。

narrative.en: Massive context windows transform AI into domain co-pilots capable of ingesting vast documentation. However, quadratic O(N²) memory consumption remains a critical bottleneck, accelerating research in Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) and state-space architectures like Mamba.
narrative.zhHans: 超长上下文极具实用价值，使得 AI 成为可以一次性吞入整本API文档甚至整个小型项目代码库的超级专家；然而对于更长的上下文，二次方计算复杂度仍然是巨大挑战，学术界正基于 RoPE 以及新型的 Mamba 状态空间结构展开突围。

title.zhHans: 自主协同 Agent 与群体智能

summary.en: Evolving from reactive chat assistants to autonomous actors with distinct intents, memory structures, and self-reflection loops, completing end-to-end operational pipelines without oversight.
summary.zhHans: 从受指令驱动的“对话助手”演进为具备独立意图、记忆检索、长程规划与自我修正能力的软件实体，能够在无人干预的情况下编排极其复杂的企业级工程工作流。

narrative.en: The defining transition is shifting inference computational budgets to runtime, letting models reflect and route tasks for seconds or minutes before outputting. This reduces hallucination rates while enabling complex loop pipelines like self-testing and self-debugging.
narrative.zhHans: Agent 的最大转变是将传统生成中的推理时间（Inference Time）前置，允许模型在输出答案前独立循环思考几秒至几分钟。这一层“思维链长考”极大地压低了幻觉，并使 Agent 具备了编写自身测试、编译出错、自动修改等行为循环。

title.en: Embodied AI: Neural Control for Robotics
title.zhHans: 物理世界交互：人形机器人的大脑

summary.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models interface with hardware, allowing bipedal systems to master dexterous hand-eye coordination tasks without prior training.
summary.zhHans: 视觉语言动作大模型（VLA）与仿生硬件深度结合，机器人脱离硬编码，零样本泛化地在非结构化环境中执行高难度手眼协调任务。

narrative.en: The developmental shift focuses on backpropagation in physical environments. Harnessing action token pipelines, models process physical sensory feeds (rigidity, mass, inertia) concurrently to enable tasks once deemed impossible, such as managing soft fabrics or complex wiring.
narrative.zhHans: 这一阶段的重心从单纯的模拟器训练转移到了“真实物理世界的反向传播”，机器人在现实交互中感知阻力与重力。依靠高度压缩的多模态感知信息和动作序列联合训练，AI 实现了让机械臂掌握折叠柔软衣物、精细扭拧螺丝等曾被视为天堑的能力。

title.zhHans: AI 驱动的科学发现引擎

summary.en: Across bio-physics, battery chemistry, and fusion dynamics, AI evolves from pattern-matching to formulating hypotheses, directing automated lab arrays for massive discovery cycles.
summary.zhHans: 在生物物理、前沿材料等领域，AI 自主提出假说、设计闭环湿实验室，极大加速了人类的科学探索周期。

narrative.en: Autonomous closed-loop wet laboratories iterate molecular synthesis around the clock. By identifying advanced topological arrangements, AI enables dramatic breakthroughs in battery design, custom bio-therapeutics, and super-conductive compound matching.
narrative.zhHans: 这一里程碑式的跃升意味着 AI 实验室能够在无人监督下开展化学合成，全天候迭代。由于 AI 能够识别极度复杂的拓扑网络结构，因此在新型常温超导材料搜索、抗癌靶向药分子设计以及电池正负极材料革新上，其产出速度会呈几个数量级爆发。

summary.en: Systems achieve generalized cognitive abstraction, mastering unfamiliar domains dynamically while expressing fluid flexibility in intellectual, virtual, and physically adaptive tasks.

description.zhHans: 在这个历史节点上，AI 开始具备自我迭代其本身神经网络代码的能力，这通常伴随着算力的极度膨胀和去中心化安全架构的建立。社会工作的结构和全球生产力模型将面临重构，安全与共生的治理框架将成为世界级的首要议题。

text.en: Systems achieve generalized cognitive abstraction, mastering unfamiliar domains dynamically while expressing fluid flexibility in intellectual, virtual, and physically adaptive tasks.
text.zhHans: 系统展现出强大的通识与抽象推理本领，能零成本地掌握全新行业知识，在知识工作和物理操作层面展现出等同于顶尖人类水平的多样性。
